result.evidence_quote: This study evaluated the association of Chuanhuang Patent Formula (CHPF) with short-term renal function parameters and long-term prognosis in patients with acute kidney injury (AKI) on chronic kidney disease (CKD) (A on C) and explored potential subgroups that might derive greater benefit.
result.rationale: The study evaluates treatment outcomes in acute kidney injury on chronic kidney disease. It does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
